# Palm Beach AI Services

> Founder-run websites, local SEO + Google Business Profile management, and AI automation for Palm Beach County, Florida home-service businesses. Based in Royal Palm Beach, FL. Phone (561) 365-8443.

- Pricing: one plan. A $750 one-time custom website build, then $297/month (month-to-month, no contract). The monthly plan includes review automation, Google Business Profile management, lead follow-up, a monthly check-in, backlink building, and competitor analysis + ranking improvement.
- Custom AI automation (CRM/GoHighLevel setup, custom AI workflows, AI Workday Install) is quoted per project.
- Clients own their website, domain, Google profile, and data.
- Delivery promise: websites live in 7 days from content; full setup live in 14 days or month one is free. No ranking or revenue guarantees.
- Service area: Palm Beach County (Royal Palm Beach, Wellington, West Palm Beach, Lake Worth Beach, Greenacres, Jupiter, Boca Raton and more), plus Martin and Broward counties.
